noTrackingDescription: Academica does not use third-party tracking cookies or analytics services. We use only first-party, privacy-safe analytics to improve our service.
coppaDescription: We comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). For users under 13, we require parental consent before collecting any personal information.
gdprDescription: We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Users in the EU have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability, and object to processing of their personal data.
leaderboardDescription: The leaderboard is opt-in only. When you opt in, only your chosen display alias, XP, and level are shown publicly. Your real name, email, and other personal information are never displayed.
notificationDescription: Notifications are processed with minimal data. We only store the notification type, title, body, and read status. No personal content from your learning activities is included in notifications.
accountDeletionDescription: Account deletion is permanent and irreversible. All your data including profile, progress, journal entries, and achievements will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
